title: Observed storage = climate reference + residual
caption:
Naturalized WaterGAP is used directly. Residual = GRACE-based storage − naturalized WaterGAP.
Residual includes possible human influence, omitted processes, and model/measurement errors; it is not observed pumping.

title: Residual = model-estimated human effect + remaining discrepancy
caption:
Human effect = historical − naturalized WaterGAP. Discrepancy = GRACE-based storage − historical WaterGAP.
The identity is exact bookkeeping; groundwater/reservoir observations cannot separately identify both terms.

title: TWSA: climate and residual components across Thailand
caption:
Six geographically distributed examples, selected without using validation performance. Each panel uses its own vertical scale.
The two curves sum to GRACE-based storage on common dates; missing observations remain gaps.

title: TWSA: annual climate and residual variability
caption:
Boxes: monthly absolute departures / annual observed mean absolute deviation; lines: annual mean of that ratio (≥8 months).
These are variability ratios, not causal contribution percentages; they need not sum to one and may exceed one.

title: GWSA: annual climate and residual variability
caption:
Boxes: monthly absolute departures / annual observed mean absolute deviation; lines: annual mean of that ratio (≥8 months).
These are variability ratios, not causal contribution percentages; they need not sum to one and may exceed one.

title: Groundwater observations versus the combined residual
caption:
Annual paired dates; higher head index means shallower groundwater. Standardization compares timing, not water volume.
Well-network membership varies through time; short records and groundwater responses to both rainfall and pumping limit attribution.

title: Independent reservoir storage versus the combined TWSA residual
caption:
Scene-supported Level 1 reservoir estimates; fixed reservoir panel; gaps retained, no interpolation or zero filling.
Adjustment removes calendar month and linear trend. Reservoirs represent only part of TWSA and reflect climate as well as operations.

title: Spatial consistency with groundwater and reservoir observations
caption:
Hatching: fewer than 8 paired groundwater years or 24 paired reservoir months; thresholds indicate support, not significance.
Reservoir adjustment removes season and trend. Maps show associations with the combined residual, not causal human validation.

title: Groundwater evidence: six geographic basin examples
caption:
Same six basins as the component figures; weak and short-record relationships are retained. Regression lines are descriptive.
Water-level and storage units differ: correlations test timing consistency, not agreement in storage magnitude or human pumping.

title: A direct-model framework for testing attribution limits
caption:
The analysis tests robustness and physical consistency; it does not identify all residual storage as human-caused.
Climate reconstruction and residence-time fitting are excluded from this design.

title: Do declines survive gravity and soil-component choices?
caption:
Intervals: conditional two-year calendar-block wild regression; they do not include all satellite/model uncertainty.
Regional groups aggregate reporting basins, not new independent GRACE measurements; TWSA does not depend on soil choice.

title: Residual trend magnitude and its processing sensitivity
caption:
Median/range across two gravity products and, for GWSA, two soil estimates. Other subtraction terms are held fixed.
A narrow range within this tested set is not proof of small total uncertainty; basin-scale GRACE support remains coarse.

title: How strongly does the storage difference depend on the reference?
caption:
Exact common 2002–2021 support and 2004–2009 reference. LPJmL/MIROC are structural diagnostics, excluded from full-TWS evidence flags.
Their groundwater accounting is not verified as equivalent to WaterGAP; nowatermgt can retain other historical human forcings.

title: Basin storage differences across four reference simulations
caption:
TWSA differences, common 2002–2021 support. LPJmL/MIROC are structural diagnostics, not verified equivalent full-TWS baselines.
Only the two WaterGAP variants enter baseline-robustness flags. Differences combine forcing, model structure and experiment definitions.

title: What do independent observations support?
caption:
Wells: 2013–2022, ≥8 paired years; station-bootstrap intervals conditional on observed years (changing/strict panels).
Reservoirs: ≥24 scene-supported months; year-cluster intervals. Correlations are not causal attribution or storage-volume validation.

title: Rainfall amount, concentration and dry spells: 2003–2023
caption:
CHIRPS v2 daily at native 0.05° pixel centres, cosine-latitude area weights. Higher Gini means more concentrated daily rainfall.
Local indices are calculated per grid cell before basin averaging; dry days have rainfall <1 mm. Daily CHIRPS is a derived rainfall product.

title: National rainfall concentration and storage variability
caption:
Storage: mean deseasonalized anomaly on common dates, ≥8 observed months per year; no mission-gap filling.
Rainfall and Gini use full calendar years. This display is descriptive; the controlled analysis also includes annual PET and time.

title: Does rainfall concentration add information beyond rainfall totals?
caption:
Controls: annual precipitation, annual potential ET and linear time; main predictor: area-mean local daily Gini.
Two-year wild intervals; small annual samples. Positive RMSE gain means improvement. These are exploratory associations, not causal effects.

title: Spatial evidence for rainfall concentration in the residual
caption:
Hatching: q ≥ 0.05 after adjustment across all fixed basin tests (both storage variables, three responses, three rain metrics).
Basins share GRACE/climate signals. Improved explanatory fit alone does not establish a mechanism or anthropogenic influence.

title: Basin evidence: robust declines, sparse support and disagreement
caption:
Fractions describe tested variants, not probabilities; baseline flags use only two WaterGAP variants, not the structural diagnostics.
Correlations describe consistency, not causality. Missing evidence remains blank; no overall confidence score is assigned.

title: Why 22 reporting basins are not 22 independent satellite regions
caption:
Shared native weights describe overlapping sampling, not a full GRACE error covariance or independent effective sample size.
Interior sensitivity removes a 0.25° grid-cell border next to provider ocean masks; it is a stress test, not a validated coastal correction.

title: ENSO timing in storage components
caption: National partial correlations remove season, trend and contemporaneous DMI, 2003–2023. All five selected ENSO leads are shown. The residual has a weaker six-month association, but this does not prove complete climate removal.
